payload.description:
Close the crash windows between durable state and queue delivery.

Acceptance criteria:
- Appending work and requesting its logical enqueue can be retried idempotently.
- Active workers renew both their turn claim and SQS visibility.
- Each started turn schedules its own deadline or watchdog; there is no idle polling process.
- Recovery creates at most one next attempt or a visible terminal state.
- Ambiguous provider outcomes have an explicit reconciliation state.
payload.title: Implement idempotent handoff and turn-triggered recovery
